correctness.rationale: A length-k sliding window attains every one-count between its extremes. The extremal 2- and 3-one span lengths recover unordered inner gaps; max length with at most two ones recovers unordered outer gaps; the at-most-one-one span distinguishes pair orientations except at the exact beta>=A threshold. Degenerate equal gaps give only reversals. Unique representatives with a<d<=b<c prove the generating function, with asymptotics by standard pole/lattice enumeration. Every predicted Parikh-set fiber was independently reconstructed by direct substring scanning for all 12,650 words of lengths 3..24.
